subject: phantom_lancer_phantom_edge
definition: 一次施放或一次攻击能对多个敌方单位造成伤害
definition_note: U71：定义是助手草稿；只打单个目标的不算；分裂攻击同时记分裂溅射
evidence: 每当幻影长矛手冲锋时穿过敌人，他就会制造并列幻象攻击他们。

context.description_en: When targeting an enemy for an attack, Phantom Lancer quickly charges into range, gaining increased movement speed and evasion.
context.description_zh: 对目标发动攻击后，幻影长矛手将快速向其冲去，获得移动速度和闪避提升。
notes_en: If the attack order is cancelled, the movement speed bonus is lost.
Rush movement speed is %bonus_speed%.
notes_zh: 如果冲锋中途取消攻击指令，那么移动速度加成就会消失。
冲锋过程中移动速度为%bonus_speed%。

scepter_loc.en: Increases Range. Whenever Phantom Lancer Rushes through enemies, he creates Juxtapose illusions that attack them. Additionally, every %illusion_spawn_travel_distance% units rushed creates a Juxtapose illusion that rushes to the target alongside Phantom Lancer.
scepter_loc.zh: 提升距离。每当幻影长矛手冲锋时穿过敌人，他就会制造并列幻象攻击他们。另外，每冲锋%illusion_spawn_travel_distance%距离还会在幻影长矛手身旁制造一个并列幻象，向目标冲去。

subject: puck_illusory_orb
definition: 一次施放或一次攻击能对多个敌方单位造成伤害
definition_note: U71：定义是助手草稿；只打单个目标的不算；分裂攻击同时记分裂溅射
evidence: 帕克向路线方向发出一个魔法球，对经过路径上的敌人造成伤害。
法球每%damage_interval%秒会在作用范围内额外造成%damage_over_time_pct%%%击中伤害，但超过最大施法距离后法球会被摧毁。
Puck launches a magic orb that travels along the path, damaging enemy units along the way.
The orb deals an additional %damage_over_time_pct%%% of its impact damage every %damage_interval%s in its area of effect, but if it exceeds the max cast range it will be destroyed.

context.description_en:
Vector Targeted. Puck launches a magic orb that travels along the path, damaging enemy units along the way. The orb deals an additional %damage_over_time_pct%%% of its impact damage every %damage_interval%s in its area of effect, but if it exceeds the max cast range it will be destroyed.

 At any point, Puck may teleport to the orb's location using Ethereal Jaunt. Can be put on alt-cast to launch the Orb straight ahead.
context.description_zh:
以矢量为目标。帕克向路线方向发出一个魔法球，对经过路径上的敌人造成伤害。法球每%damage_interval%秒会在作用范围内额外造成%damage_over_time_pct%%%击中伤害，但超过最大施法距离后法球会被摧毁。

在幻象法球飞行过程中，帕克可以使用灵动之翼来传送到法球所在的位置。可以设为多样施法（右键点击技能栏图标），让法球的路线为向前的直线。
notes_en: The Illusory Orb grants unobstructed vision around its location while it travels.
Jaunting to the Orb will disjoint projectiles.
notes_zh: 幻象法球在飞行途中提供顺畅视野。
将自己传送到幻象法球可以躲避攻击和技能弹道。

subject: puck_waning_rift
definition: 一次施放或一次攻击能对多个敌方单位造成伤害
definition_note: U71：定义是助手草稿；只打单个目标的不算；分裂攻击同时记分裂溅射
evidence: 帕克传送至目标地点洒出它神秘的仙女粉尘，对周围的敌人造成伤害和沉默。
Puck teleports to the target location and releases a burst of faerie dust that deals damage and silences enemy units nearby.

context.description_en: Puck teleports to the target location and releases a burst of faerie dust that deals damage and silences enemy units nearby.
context.description_zh: 帕克传送至目标地点洒出它神秘的仙女粉尘，对周围的敌人造成伤害和沉默。

subject: puck_phase_shift
definition: 一次施放或一次攻击能对多个敌方单位造成伤害
definition_note: U71：定义是助手草稿；只打单个目标的不算；分裂攻击同时记分裂溅射
evidence: 帕克每次施放相位转移时对攻击距离内所有敌人发动一次攻击。

context.description_en: CHANNELED - Puck briefly shifts into another dimension where it is immune from harm.
context.description_zh: 持续施法 - 帕克暂时将自己转移到另一个位面，从而免疫伤害。
notes_en: Puck retains collision size while under the effects of Phase Shift.
Issuing any action will cancel Phase Shift.
Puck is invulnerable during Phase Shift.
notes_zh: 帕克在相位转移状态下依然具有碰撞体积。
进行任何动作都会中止相位转移。
帕克在相位转移状态下无敌。

shard_loc.en: Puck's attacks deal bonus magic damage. Puck attacks all enemies within its attack range every time it phase shifts.
shard_loc.zh: 帕克的攻击造成额外魔法伤害。帕克每次施放相位转移时对攻击距离内所有敌人发动一次攻击。

subject: puck_dream_coil
definition: 一次施放或一次攻击能对多个敌方单位造成伤害
definition_note: U71：定义是助手草稿；只打单个目标的不算；分裂攻击同时记分裂溅射
evidence: 梦境缠绕作用下的所有敌人都会被帕克攻击，攻击频率基于帕克攻击频率的%attack_rate_pct%%%。

context.description_en: Creates a coil of volatile magic that latches onto enemy Heroes, damaging and leashing them.  If the enemy hero stretches the coil by moving too far away, it snaps, stunning and dealing additional damage.
context.description_zh: 创造一个变化无常的的魔法梦境来困住敌方英雄，对他们造成伤害和束缚。如果被困住的敌方英雄试图挣脱缠绕走出梦境，将因为梦境破碎而受到眩晕和额外伤害。

scepter_loc.en: All enemies affected by Dream Coil are attacked at a rate equal to %attack_rate_pct%%% of Puck's attack rate. The attacks continue while the target is stunned if they break the Dream Coil.
scepter_loc.zh: 梦境缠绕作用下的所有敌人都会被帕克攻击，攻击频率基于帕克攻击频率的%attack_rate_pct%%%。即使目标挣脱梦境，被眩晕时攻击也会继续。

subject: pudge_meat_hook
definition: 一次施放或一次攻击能对多个敌方单位造成伤害
definition_note: U71：定义是助手草稿；只打单个目标的不算；分裂攻击同时记分裂溅射
evidence: 勾住第一个遭遇的单位，并将它拖到帕吉身边，如果是非远古单位会被秒杀，其他敌方单位则是受到伤害。

context.description_en: Launches a bloody hook toward a unit or location. The hook will snag the first unit it encounters, dragging the unit back to Pudge, killing it if it's a non-ancient creep and dealing damage if it is an enemy otherwise.
context.description_zh: 向一个单位或方向射出血腥的肉钩。勾住第一个遭遇的单位，并将它拖到帕吉身边，如果是非远古单位会被秒杀，其他敌方单位则是受到伤害。
notes_en: Interrupts channeling spells of the primary target if it's an enemy.
Meat Hook hits invisible units.
Meat Hook can go through trees, cliffs, buildings, ancient units and Roshan.
Meat Hook can drag friendly units, but they won't be damaged.
Meat Hook can hit and drag runes to Pudge, refunding the Hook's mana cost.
notes_zh: 钩中敌人后将打断持续施法类技能。
肉钩能击中隐身单位。
肉钩可以穿过树木、地形、建筑、远古生物和肉山。
肉钩可以拖拽友方单位，不过他们不会受到伤害。
肉钩可以将神符拖拽至帕吉身旁，并返还肉钩的魔法消耗。

shard_loc.en: When Meat Hook hits an enemy, it deals bonus damage based on the distance pulled.When Meat Hook hits an ally, Meat Hook's cooldown is reduced by %cooldown_reduction_pct_allied_hook%%%.
shard_loc.zh: 肉钩击中敌人时会根据牵引距离造成额外伤害。肉钩击中友军时，肉钩的冷却时间会减少%cooldown_reduction_pct_allied_hook%%%。

subject: pudge_rot
definition: 一次施放或一次攻击能对多个敌方单位造成伤害
definition_note: U71：定义是助手草稿；只打单个目标的不算；分裂攻击同时记分裂溅射
evidence: 能够造成持续伤害并减缓敌人移动速度的毒性云雾——同时对敌军和自身造成伤害。
A toxic cloud that deals intense damage and slows movement--harming not only enemy units but Pudge himself.

context.description_en: A toxic cloud that deals intense damage and slows movement--harming not only enemy units but Pudge himself.
context.description_zh: 能够造成持续伤害并减缓敌人移动速度的毒性云雾——同时对敌军和自身造成伤害。
notes_en: Using Rot doesn't interrupt channeling.
Rot hits invisible units.
If Pudge is silenced, he can't deactivate Rot if it's activated.
Rot self-damage is non-lethal.
notes_zh: 使用腐烂不会打断持续施法。
腐烂能伤害隐身单位。
即使帕吉在开启腐烂后被沉默，腐烂也不会关闭。
腐烂的对己伤害不致死。

scepter_loc.en: Increases Rot radius by %bonus_rot_radius%, damage by %bonus_rot_damage%, and causes it to reduce enemy Health Restoration by %scepter_rot_regen_reduction_pct%%%.
scepter_loc.zh: 腐烂的作用范围提升%bonus_rot_radius%，伤害提升%bonus_rot_damage%点，并且可以降低敌人的%scepter_rot_regen_reduction_pct%%%生命回复。

subject: pudge_dismember
definition: 一次施放或一次攻击能对多个敌方单位造成伤害
definition_note: U71：定义是助手草稿；只打单个目标的不算；分裂攻击同时记分裂溅射
evidence: 持续施法 - 帕吉撕咬一个敌方单位，使其失去行动能力并受到持续伤害。

context.description_en: CHANNELED - Pudge chows down on an enemy unit, disabling it and dealing damage over time. Damage is increased by Pudge's Strength and heals him for the total amount. Pudge pulls the unit at a rate of %pull_units_per_second% units, up to a minimum of %pull_distance_limit% range.
context.description_zh: 持续施法 - 帕吉撕咬一个敌方单位，使其失去行动能力并受到持续伤害。伤害量为基础伤害加上帕吉力量值的一定百分比，帕吉将回复与伤害量相等的生命。帕吉会将该单位以每秒%pull_units_per_second%的速度向自身牵引，最多牵引%pull_distance_limit%距离。
notes_en: If a unit becomes invisible while Dismembered, it will still be under the effects of Dismember.
notes_zh: 即使肢解的目标在受到作用的过程中隐身，还是不会脱离肢解的作用。

subject: razor_plasma_field
definition: 一次施放或一次攻击能对多个敌方单位造成伤害
definition_note: U71：定义是助手草稿；只打单个目标的不算；分裂攻击同时记分裂溅射
evidence: 释放一波威力随扩张程度提升的等离子能量场，收缩时也会对经过的敌人造成伤害和减速。
Releases a wave of energetic plasma that grows in power as it expands, but also zaps on contraction, slowing and dealing damage to enemy units caught in its path.

context.description_en: Releases a wave of energetic plasma that grows in power as it expands, but also zaps on contraction, slowing and dealing damage to enemy units caught in its path. Damage and slow increases with distance from Razor. The Plasma Field hits each unit twice, once each direction.
context.description_zh: 释放一波威力随扩张程度提升的等离子能量场，收缩时也会对经过的敌人造成伤害和减速。距离雷泽越远，伤害和减速越高。等离子场对每个单位造成两次伤害。

subject: razor_storm_surge
definition: 一次施放或一次攻击能对多个敌方单位造成伤害
definition_note: U71：定义是助手草稿；只打单个目标的不算；分裂攻击同时记分裂溅射
evidence: 被攻击时拥有几率、每次受到指向性技能时都会释放一道叉状闪电，击中目标和附近其他敌人，优先打击与目标类型相同的单位，造成伤害并减缓移动速度。

There's a chance when attacked, and always when targeted with a spell, to release a forked lightning that strikes the target and other nearby enemies, prioritizing the unit type of the attacker, dealing damage and slowing movement speed.

context.description_en: There's a chance when attacked, and always when targeted with a spell, to release a forked lightning that strikes the target and other nearby enemies, prioritizing the unit type of the attacker, dealing damage and slowing movement speed.
context.description_zh: 被攻击时拥有几率、每次受到指向性技能时都会释放一道叉状闪电，击中目标和附近其他敌人，优先打击与目标类型相同的单位，造成伤害并减缓移动速度。
notes_en: Damage done by this ability is considered reflected damage. Reflected damage does not provide any lifesteal and cannot be reflected.
notes_zh: 这个技能造成的伤害被视为反弹伤害。反弹伤害不提供任何吸血，而且无法反弹。

shard_loc.en: While Eye of the Storm is active, strike chance is %eye_of_the_storm_chance_multiplier%x as high, strike cooldown is reduced by %strike_cd_reduction_during_storm%s, and Lightning strikes all enemies within Eye of the Storm's radius. Does not apply to the same enemy twice from a single instance.
shard_loc.zh: 风暴之眼开启时，打击几率为%eye_of_the_storm_chance_multiplier%倍，打击冷却时间减少%strike_cd_reduction_during_storm%秒，而且闪电会打击风暴之眼范围内所有敌人。单次伤害不会对同个敌人施加两次。

每次打击都会以范围内血量最低的敌方单位为目标。

context.description_en: A powerful lightning storm strikes out at the enemy unit with the lowest health, dealing damage and reducing armor.
context.description_zh: 强大的闪电风暴，打击生命值最低的敌方单位，造成伤害并削弱护甲。

Eye of the Storm will prioritize striking static linked heroes.

风暴之眼优先打击受到静电连接作用的英雄。
连续施放的风暴之眼可以叠加。

scepter_loc.zh: 风暴之眼可以同时打击两个目标，并且能对建筑造成伤害。打击建筑时，只会以防御塔、兵营和遗迹作为目标。
